The country of caste and the grave of unborn ambitions; the country of dirt and superstition; the cradle of plagues and epidemics and famines; the land of the noblest palaces and temples, as well as of the meanest hovels which serve as dwellings for its sad-eyed patient inhabitants.

arxiv-2209-01261.title: Splashes in isotropic media
arxiv-2209-01261.creator: Eugene B. Kolomeisky
arxiv-2209-01261.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Eugene B. Kolomeisky. The response of a weakly absorbing isotropic medium to a sudden localized perturbation (a ”splash”) is explained within the framework of linear response theory. In this theory splashes result from the interference of the collective excitations of the medium, with the outcome determined by the interplay between their phase and group velocities as well as the sign of the latter.

arxiv-2308-07982.title: The canonical quantization of the cosmic fluid in the pre-inflationary era : a new kind of Emergent Universe.
arxiv-2308-07982.creator: Subhayan Maity, Sujayita Bakra
arxiv-2308-07982.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Subhayan Maity, Sujayita Bakra. The early phase of cosmic evolution is still a great topic of interest to the cosmologist community. Especially the mechanism behind the origin of the Universe is yet to be resolved. Most people believe in the Big Bang models (singular origin of the Universe), but fewer of the cosmologists support in favor of the non-singular origin of the Universe in their works. These models are based on the standard general theory of relativity.

arxiv-2312-12646.title: Disentangling Multiple Emitting Components in Molecular Observations with Non-negative Matrix Factorization
arxiv-2312-12646.creator: Damien de Mijolla, Jonathan Holdship, Serena Viti, Johannes Heyl
arxiv-2312-12646.description: Abstract Molecular emission from the galactic and extragalactic interstellar medium (ISM) is often used to determine the physical conditions of the dense gas. However, even from spatially resolved regions, the observed molecules are not necessarily arising from a single component. Disentangling multiple gas components is often a degenerate problem in radiative transfer studies.

arxiv-2403-11646.title: MedMerge: Merging Models for Effective Transfer Learning to Medical Imaging Tasks
arxiv-2403-11646.creator: Ibrahim Almakky, Santosh Sanjeev, Anees Ur Rehman Hashmi, Mohammad Areeb Qazi, Hu Wang, Mohammad Yaqub
arxiv-2403-11646.description: Abstract Transfer learning has become a powerful tool to initialize deep learning models to achieve faster convergence and higher performance. This is especially useful in the medical imaging analysis domain, where data scarcity limits possible performance gains for deep learning models.

arxiv-2503-11513.creator: Ziqin Zhou, Yifan Yang, Yuqing Yang, Tianyu He, Houwen Peng, Kai Qiu, Qi Dai, Lili Qiu, Chong Luo, Lingqiao Liu

arxiv-2505-21282.title: EgoWalk: A Multimodal Dataset for Robot Navigation in the Wild
arxiv-2505-21282.creator: TIMUR AKHTYAMOV 1,*, MOHAMAD AL MDFAA 1,* JAVIER ANTONIO RAMIREZ BENAVIDES 1 ARTHUR NIGMATZYANOV 1 SERGEY BAKULIN 1 GERMAN DEVCHICH 1 DENIS FATYKHOV 1 DIEGO RUIZ SALINAS 1 ALEXANDER MAZUROV 1 KRISTINA ZIPA 1 MALIK MOHRAT 2 PAVEL KOLESNIK 2 IVAN SOSIN 2, GONZALO FERRER 1
arxiv-2505-21282.description: Abstract Data-driven navigation algorithms are critically dependent on large-scale, high-quality real-world data collection for successful training and robust performance in realistic and uncontrolled conditions. To enhance the growing family of navigation-related real-world datasets, we introduce EgoWalk — a dataset of 50 hours of human navigation in a diverse set of indoor/outdoor, varied seasons, and location environments.

arxiv-2507-14491.title: Numerical Artifacts in Learning Dynamical Systems
arxiv-2507-14491.creator: Bing‑Ze Lu, Richard Tsai
arxiv-2507-14491.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Bing‑Ze Lu, Richard Tsai. In many applications, one needs to learn a dynamical system from its solutions sampled at a finite number of time points. The learning problem is often formulated as an optimization problem over a chosen function class. However, in the optimization procedure, it is necessary to employ a numerical scheme to integrate candidate dynamical systems and assess how their solutions fit the data. This paper reveals potentially serious effects of a chosen numerical scheme on the learning outcome.

pmc-12651726.title: Interpretable and Performant Multimodal Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma GTV Segmentation with Clinical Priors Guided 3D-Gaussian-Prompted Diffusion Model (3DGS-PDM)
pmc-12651726.creator: Jiarui Zhu, Zongrui Ma, Ge Ren, Jing Cai, Avraham Eisbruch
pmc-12651726.description: Simple SummaryThis is the first study to utilize 3D Gaussian representations and a Gaussian-prompt diffusion model for performant and interpretable multimodal medical imaging segmentation. Our proposed 3D Gaussian-prompted diffusion model addresses two long-standing challenges in this area: (1) accuracy limitation caused by heavy information redundancy and (2) intepretability defectiveness caused by unreliable information extraction and integration from multimodal inputs.

Materials and Methods: This retrospective cohort study included 34 patients with MPA who received rituximab.

pmc-13027001.creator: Hongyan Jiang, Yizhe Wang, Shichun Chen, Shuran Liao, Tingxu Chen, Xiaoqing Wang
pmc-13027001.description: Simple SummaryStephanitis chinensis (tea lace bug) is a major pest in China’s southwest tea region, with recent outbreaks severely impacting the profitability of spring tea. To clarify its distribution dynamics under current and future climate change, this study used the MaxEnt model and ArcGIS to predict its distribution and dominant environmental factors.

pmc-13158765.title: Synergistic HA–tooth graft composite promotes rapid alveolar bone healing via IL-6 suppression and OCN enhancement
pmc-13158765.creator: Dwi Wahyu Indrawati, Ernie Maduratna Setiawatie, Retno Pudji Rahayu, Shafira Kurnia Supandi, Rizky Briliant Syah Manurung, Mohammed Ahmed Aljunaid, Astari Puteri
pmc-13158765.description: BackgroundPeriodontitis leads to continuous alveolar bone destruction driven by persistent inflammation, particularly elevated interleukin-6 (IL-6). Bone healing after tooth extraction under periodontitis conditions is often impaired, highlighting the need for regenerative biomaterials that can regulate inflammation and support osteogenesis. The hyaluronic acid–bovine tooth graft (HA + BTG) combination has been proposed as a promising BioGel-Graft candidate for accelerated bone regeneration.

pmc-13411585.creator: Honglei Zhang, Cheng Zhang, Chen Qiu, Yukai Xiang, Zhaoyan Jiang, Liang Zheng, Hai Hu, Yulong Yang
pmc-13411585.description: BackgroundBenign gallbladder disease, including gallstones, gallbladder polyps, and gallbladder adenomyosis, is one of the most common disorders of the digestive system worldwide and poses a substantial clinical and economic burden. pmc-13458551.title: Cenomanian theropod teeth from Algora (central Spain), new evidence for majungasaurine abelisaurids in Europe
pmc-13458551.creator: Mirella López-Miguel, Angélica Torices, Elisabete Malafaia, Francisco Ortega, Adán Pérez-García
pmc-13458551.description: In this work 40 isolated teeth of theropod dinosaurs from the Cenomanian (Upper Cretaceous) locality of Algora are described. The paleontological area of Algora (Guadalajara province, Spain) provides the highest concentration of macroremains of Cenomanian vertebrates in southwestern Europe. Isolated theropod teeth are the most abundant remains in Algora as far as this group is concerned.
